name: Simpson's Rule Integration
aliases: Simpson's Rule Integration for Extinction Sampling
definition: A numerical integration technique used to sample the extinction function σ_t(x) along the ray to reduce aliasing artefacts when particles are large and few in number.
summary: Simpson's Rule Integration is a deterministic numerical technique that reduces aliasing in volume ray casting by approximating extinction integrals with superior accuracy over Taylor series and lower variance than Monte Carlo methods.
